name: HEIR (Homomorphic Encryption)
summary: Compiler for Homomorphic Encryption Intermediate Representation.
analysis: Enables privacy-preserving compute (FHE) on public untrusted servers. Strategic for the 'Quantum Hive' initiative to allow agents to process sensitive data without decrypting it.

name: XNNPACK
summary: High-efficiency floating-point neural network inference operators.
analysis: Foundational library for optimized edge inference (ARM64/x86/WASM). Valuable for Phase 4 (Edge Sovereignty) when deploying local models to low-power Hive nodes.

name: deps.dev API
summary: API for querying dependency graphs, licenses, and security advisories for open source packages.
analysis: Critical upstream data source for the Security Bee (Hive Immunity Sprint). Enables autonomous auditing of the Hive's software supply chain and 'Radioactive Content' checking via OpenSSF Scorecards.

name: Google Style Guides
summary: Official style guides for Google-originated open-source projects.
analysis: Critical for standardizing the Hive's Python and JS codebases. Enforcing these styles ensures high readability for agents and humans.

name: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)
summary: Standardized common language for agent trading and checkout.
analysis: The overarching framework for agentic commerce. Enables standardized discovery and checkout. Explicitly supports AP2 (logged previously). Needed for the Marketplace layer of the Hive.

name: A2A x402 Extension
summary: Brings cryptocurrency payments to the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol.
analysis: Revives HTTP 402 for agents. Enables on-chain, decentralized payments between agents. Crucial for Hive economic sovereignty (Treasury Bee).

name: Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)
summary: Google's open standard for secure, interoperable AI-driven payments.
analysis: Foundations for the Hive Treasury. Enables standardized economic transactions for agents. Detailed Python/Android samples available.

name: Gemini Agent Cookbook
summary: Implementation of Anthropic agentic workflows using Google Gemini 2.0
analysis: CRITICAL resource. Implements true Agentic Patterns (Orchestrator, Routing, etc.) on Gemini 2.0. This is the missing link for our Hive Orchestrator.

name: Reverse Engineering Cookbook
summary: Comprehensive guide for Android and Web reverse engineering (Frida, Unidbg).
analysis: High-value sovereign capability resource. Covers advanced topics like JSVMP and Unidbg. Essential coverage for the Security Bee.

summary: Open-Source Framework for Globally Distributed Low-Communication Training. Note: Superseded by 'prime' repo.

name: GitHub: stanfordnlp/dspy
summary: The framework for programming—not prompting—language models. Declarative Self-improving Python.
analysis: Essential framework for the 'Ontology Manager' evolution. Moves beyond static prompts to programmable, self-optimizing pipelines. Key for 'Mad Libs' eradication strategy. Allows optimizing prompts vs weights.

name: GitHub: cube-js/cube
summary: Cube Core is an open-source semantic layer for AI, BI and embedded analytics. Abstracts data sources into metrics/dimensions.
analysis: Mature, industry-standard semantic layer. Less 'AI-native' than Semantica, more BI-focused. Good for structural analytics (e.g., Polymarket PnL dashboards) but potentially heavy for sovereign agentic memory. Headless API is a plus.

name: GitHub: Hawksight-AI/semantica
summary: Open Source Semantic Layer & Knowledge Engineering Framework. Transforms unstructured data into structured Knowledge Graphs.
analysis: Candidate for 'Core Cognitive Infrastructure'. Offers a complete pipeline for GraphRAG, Triplets, and Ontology management. Directly relevant to the 'HiveKnowledgeGraph' work in Phase 1 (Cognee alternative or supplement). Features 'Context Engineering' and 'Memory Systems'.

name: GitHub: nsbradford/ai-devtool-leaderboard
summary: Source code for the AI Code Review Adoption Tracker. Tracks PR review events via GH Archive to measure tool adoption.
analysis: Source repository for the previously logged tracker. Reveals methodology: uses Trigger.dev cron jobs, Neon serverless Postgres, and queries GH Archive BigQuery dataset. Useful reference for building similar 'sovereign' tracking tools. Confirms data scope is limited to PR reviews.

name: AI Code Review Adoption Tracker
summary: Tracks adoption of AI code review tools in active open-source repositories using data from GH Archive.
analysis: Strategic market intelligence resource. Useful for identifying emerging AI coding tools and verifying industry trends. Open source data processing (GH Archive) adds credibility. Vibe coded by Nick Bradford.
